title: Stable influence lower bound for balanced functions
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $J\\subseteq\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$. Suppose $f$ depends only on the coordinates in $J$, and let $k$ be a natural number with $|J|\\le k$. If $0<\\delta<1$ and the real-valued sign representation of $f$ has mean zero, then $(1-\\delta)^{k-1}\\le\\sum_{i\\in J}\\operatorname{Inf}_{1-\\delta}(f,i)$, where $\\operatorname{Inf}_{1-\\delta}(f,i)$ denotes the stable influence at coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: The real-valued sign representation of $f$ has mean zero
